es.description: Una de las señas de identidad de Gijón es que no todos los proyectos de ciudad emanan de la Casa Consistorial, ya sea por iniciativa del gobierno local de turno o por una propuesta plenaria de algún partido de la oposición. La capital marítima del Principado siempre ha llevado a gala el tener detrás un amplio tejido asociativo, en cada barrio y en cada parroquia, que ha sabido tender puentes, abrir puertas y, en definitiva, mejorar la vida de los gijoneses. Echando la vista atrás, por citar solo algunos ejemplos, ahí está la bicentenaria Fundación Hospital de Jove o la Asociación Gijonesa de Caridad, que impulsó la Cocina Económica y que el pasado curso celebró sus 120 años de actividad. Podríamos incluso retrotraernos a las iniciativas de Jovellanos, pero lo que está claro es que pasan los siglos y el mismo espíritu se mantiene a esta orilla del Cantábrico. Mar de Niebla selló esta semana el último ejemplo.

gr.title: Τι να φάτε το βράδυ για να κοιμάστε καλύτερα
gr.description: Τι έδειξαν έρευνες του Παν. Θεσσαλίας (ΤΕΦΑΑ) σε συνεργασία με πανεπιστήμια της Κύπρου. «Ύστερα από μια απαιτητική ημέρα, το βραδινό είναι συχνά η στιγμή που επιτέλους καθόμαστε να φάμε με ησυχία. Μπορεί, όμως, να γίνει και το μεγαλύτερο και πιο καθυστερημένο γεύμα της ημέρας. Κι ενώ φροντίζουμε το μαξιλάρι και τη θερμοκρασία του δωματίου, αξίζει να προσέξουμε και όσα έχουν προηγηθεί στο τραπέζι. Γιατί η ποσότητα και η σύνθεση του φαγητού, μαζί με την ώρα που το τρώμε, μπορούν να επηρεάσουν τη νύχτα μας». Αυτά, μεταξύ άλλων, τονίζει στο ΑΠΕ-ΜΠΕ ο Γιώργος Σακκάς, καθηγητής Άσκησης σε Κλινικούς Πληθυσμούς, ΤΕΦΑΑ, στο Πανεπιστήμιο Θεσσαλίας. Ένα βραδινό φιλικό προς τον ύπνο χρειάζεται, σύμφωνα με τον ίδιο, καταρχάς να μας χορταίνει χωρίς να μας βαραίνει. Η βάση του, όπως διαπιστώνεται από διάφορες μελέτες στο Πανεπιστήμιο Θεσσαλίας, μπορεί να είναι απλή: λαχανικά, μια μέτρια ποσότητα πρωτεΐνης και μια πηγή υδατανθράκων, με λίγο ελαιόλαδο. Αυτή η λογική μας φέρνει κοντά στη μεσογειακή διατροφή, η οποία έχει συνδεθεί με καλύτερη ποιότητα ύπνου. Το ενδιαφέρον βρίσκεται στον συνδυασμό των τροφών και στις καθημερινές συνήθειες, περισσότερο παρά σε κάποιο μεμονωμένο συστατικό. Το ψωμί, το ρύζι ή τα ζυμαρικά, λοιπόν, έχουν θέση και στο βραδινό, τονίζει ο κ. Σακκάς. Και εξηγεί: «Σε δική μας έρευνα, σε συνεργασία με πανεπιστήμια της Κύπρου, δεν διαπιστώσαμε σαφές όφελος από τον αποκλεισμό τους το βράδυ. Η έρευνα αφορούσε υγιείς άνδρες που ακολουθούσαν οργανωμένο πρόγραμμα διατροφής και άσκησης. Στην καθημερινότητα, έχει περισσότερο νόημα να δώσουμε προσοχή στην ποιότητα και στη μερίδα: ψωμί ολικής άλεσης, βρώμη, όσπρια και λαχανικά προσφέρουν φυτικές ίνες, για τις οποίες υπάρχουν ενδείξεις σύνδεσης με περισσότερο βαθύ ύπνο. Δίπλα στους υδατάνθρακες χρειάζεται και μια πηγή πρωτεΐνης, όπως ψάρι, αυγό, γιαούρτι ή όσπρια. Η πρωτεΐνη βοηθά να νιώθουμε χορτάτοι και παρέχει, μεταξύ άλλων, τρυπτοφάνη, ένα αμινοξύ που ο οργανισμός χρησιμοποιεί για να παράγει σεροτονίνη και μελατονίνη, ουσίες που συμμετέχουν στη ρύθμιση του ύπνου. Αυτό εξηγεί το επιστημονικό ενδιαφέρον, χωρίς να σημαίνει ότι ένα ποτήρι γάλα ή ένα μεγάλο πιάτο κρέας θα μας αποκοιμίσει. Η ποσότητα από μόνη της δεν φαίνεται να αρκεί. Αξίζει να δίνουμε ποικιλία στις πηγές μας, βάζοντας συχνά στο τραπέζι και φυτικές τροφές, όπως όσπρια και ξηρούς καρπούς». Το ίδιο μέτρο χρειάζεται και στα λιπαρά, σύμφωνα με τον καθηγητή Άσκησης σε κλινικούς πληθυσμούς. Για να προσθέσει στο ΑΠΕ-ΜΠΕ: «Το ελαιόλαδο, οι ανάλατοι ξηροί καρποί και τα λιπαρά ψάρια προσφέρουν ακόρεστα λιπαρά και μπορούν να εντάσσονται σε ένα ισορροπημένο διαιτολόγιο. Η υψηλότερη πρόσληψη κορεσμένων λιπαρών, που βρίσκουμε σε τρόφιμα όπως το βούτυρο και τα λιπαρά κρέατα, έχει συσχετιστεί με λιγότερο βαθύ ύπνο. Παράλληλα, ένα πολύ λιπαρό, βαρύ γεύμα μπορεί να προκαλέσει δυσφορία ή να επιδεινώσει την παλινδρόμηση σε όσους έχουν ευαισθησία. Γι' αυτό αξίζει να προσέχουμε και το μαγείρεμα: το ψητό ψάρι με λαχανικά είναι διαφορετικό βραδινό από μια μεγάλη μερίδα τηγανητών με βαριές σάλτσες. Έτσι, ένα πρακτικό βραδινό θα μπορούσε να είναι ψάρι με λαχανικά και λίγο ρύζι ή μια ομελέτα με σαλάτα και ψωμί ολικής άλεσης. Τα όσπρια αποτελούν επίσης επιλογή, σε ποσότητα που μας είναι ευχάριστη και δεν προκαλεί φούσκωμα. Οι συνδυασμοί αυτοί είναι παραδείγματα ισορροπημένου φαγητού, ο καθένας χρειάζεται να προσαρμόζει τις μερίδες στις ανάγκες του και να παρατηρεί τι του ταιριάζει. Ακόμη και το πιο προσεγμένο πιάτο, πάντως, μπορεί να μας δυσκολέψει αν το φάμε λίγο πριν ξαπλώσουμε. Καλό είναι το κύριο βραδινό να απέχει μερικές ώρες από την κατάκλιση, ιδιαίτερα όταν είναι μεγάλο. Για όσους έχουν νυχτερινές καούρες ή παλινδρόμηση, οι τρεις ώρες είναι μια χρήσιμη πρακτική αφετηρία. Αν αργότερα πεινάσουμε, ένα μικρό γιαούρτι με λίγη βρόμη είναι μια απλή επιλογή. Σκοπός είναι να νιώθουμε άνετα όταν πέφτουμε στο κρεβάτι, χωρίς πείνα ή υπερβολικά γεμάτο στομάχι». Τι να πίνετε Στο ίδιο τραπέζι, τονίζει ο κ. Σακκάς, χρειάζεται να προσέξουμε και το ποτήρι μας. Και εξηγεί: «Ένας απογευματινός καφές μπορεί να εξακολουθεί να μας κρατά σε εγρήγορση το βράδυ, ακόμη κι αν αισθανόμαστε κουρασμένοι. Η ποσότητα και η ατομική ευαισθησία μετρούν, όπως και η καφεΐνη που παίρνουμε από ενεργειακά ποτά ή δυνατό τσάι. Το αλκοόλ, από την άλλη, μπορεί αρχικά να φέρνει νύστα, αλλά αργότερα να κάνει τον ύπνο πιο διακεκομμένο. Η υπνηλία μετά το ποτό δεν εγγυάται ξεκούραση». Για να καταλήξει τονίζοντας: «Εδώ αναδεικνύεται η αξία της Ιατρικής του Τρόπου Ζωής, μιας επιστημονικά τεκμηριωμένης προσέγγισης που συνδέει τη διατροφή, την κίνηση, τον ύπνο και τη διαχείριση του στρες με τη συνολική υγεία. Για τον άνθρωπο που δυσκολεύεται να ξεκουραστεί, το βραδινό γεύμα είναι ένα κομμάτι αυτής της εικόνας. Εξίσου μετρούν η δραστηριότητα μέσα στην ημέρα, η ένταση που μεταφέρουμε στο κρεβάτι και ο χρόνος που αφήνουμε για χαλάρωση. Η Ιατρική του Τρόπου Ζωής προσφέρει ένα χρήσιμο πλαίσιο για να δουλέψουμε αυτές τις συνήθειες μαζί, με εξατομικευμένη καθοδήγηση και ρεαλιστικές αλλαγές που μπορούν να διατηρηθούν στην καθημερινότητα. Έτσι, η φροντίδα του ύπνου γίνεται μέρος μιας ευρύτερης προσπάθειας για καλύτερη υγεία και ποιότητα ζωής. Η φροντίδα του ύπνου χωρά σε απλές καθημερινές επιλογές: ένα κανονικό βραδινό, σε λογική ποσότητα και ώρα, μέσα σε μια ημέρα με κίνηση και επαρκή χρόνο για ανάπαυση. Δεν χρειάζεται να μετράμε κάθε μπουκιά με την αγωνία αν θα μας φέρει ύπνο. Χρειάζεται να δώσουμε στο σώμα μας τις κατάλληλες συνθήκες για να ξεκουραστεί. Κι όταν η δυσκολία επιμένει, να αναζητήσουμε αξιολόγηση, καθώς η χρόνια αϋπνία χρειάζεται στοχευμένη αντιμετώπιση». Με πληροφορίες από ΑΠΕ-ΜΠΕ #ΒΡΑΔΙΝΟ #ΥΠΝΟΣ

in.title: World faces energy crisis of 'unpredictability', not production: EAM Jaishankar at G20
in.description: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar told the second plenary session of the G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Atlanta that the world is facing an energy crisis caused by disruption, high costs and barriers to access rather than by any shortfall in production."Underlined that the world today stares at an energy crisis, not of production, but of unpredictability & disruption, unaffordable costs, and challenges of access," EAM Jaishankar posted on X on Friday after speaking at the session. He said he "Highlighted that deliberate attacks on energy trade & energy infrastructure are a calculated strategy to hold energy prices hostage."The minister also "Emphasised that continuous distortions of energy markets through obstacles, sanctions & chokepoints are happening with increasing frequency, greater complexity & wider impact."Turning to poorer nations, he "Underscored that there appears little regard for the predicament of low-income countries."In one of his sharpest remarks, EAM Jaishankar "Stressed that convenient distinctions are being drawn between oil and gas. Selective carveouts speak for themselves." He did not name any country or specify the carveouts he was referring to."Reiterated that the knock-on effects & mutual dependence in a globalised market should not be underestimated."On India's own needs, EAM Jaishankar "Reaffirmed that India needs reliable and predictable LPG supplies for its clean cooking needs."He also "Reiterated that India's National Mission on critical minerals spans exploration to recycling. India has also proposed a G20 Critical Minerals Circularity Initiative.""The G20 must display both understanding and leadership to keep energy markets open & predictable," EAM Jaishankar posted."It must widen access to finance and advance storage, small modular reactors, green hydrogen and bio fuels," he added. The second plenary followed the opening session earlier on Friday, where EAM Jaishankar said in a separate post that he had "Emphasised that in the face of global challenges, military solutions will not work and diplomacy must be given a chance."In that session, he also said the "Global South is disproportionately bearing the consequences of attacks on civilian shipping and seafarers, jeopardising the availability and cost of fuel, food and fertilizers."The two-day meeting is being hosted by US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and concludes on Saturday.

in.title: Poland demands free passage through Hormuz
in.description: Poland has demanded free passage through the Strait of Hormuz, with Foreign Minister RadosÅ‚aw Sikorski saying high energy costs had forced his country to pass a law to protect consumers. Atlanta, Oct 31 (IANS) Poland has demanded free passage through the Strait of Hormuz, with Foreign Minister Radosław Sikorski saying high energy costs had forced his country to pass a law to protect consumers. Speaking at a press conference during the G20 meeting, Sikorski said he had reaffirmed Poland's view that the strait was international waters during discussions on energy. He called for the "restoration of the freedom of navigation through the straits".His remarks came in response to a question about possible further US strikes on Iran and their impact on global energy supplies. Sikorski said Poland bought the largest share of its oil from Saudi Arabia, with those supplies "taken north through Suez".Qatar, he said, had supplied 9 per cent of Poland's liquefied natural gas, or LNG. He cited those imports as a reason Poland had a direct interest in restoring navigation."And of course, we are an energy consumer and importer."Sikorski said Poland had passed a special law to shield consumers and motorists from excessive petrol and diesel prices. He did not specify the measures contained in the law. He said "we are paying for this" and wanted oil prices to "come back to previous levels as soon as possible".Asked whether Polish officials had discussed Hormuz and Iran's support for Russia with Iranian officials, Sikorski replied: "Of course we did."On Tehran's response, he said "they have their view", before raising allegations of Russian assistance to Iran. He alleged that Russia was supplying Iran with targeting data and technology for hypersonic missiles "which would have the capacity to hit American warships".Sikorski questioned why that alleged assistance was "not a bigger issue". He did not provide details of the transfers or identify the systems involved. The minister also linked Europe's energy relationship with Russia to the war in Ukraine. He said Russia's return to what had been its most lucrative energy market required a fair end to the war. Most European countries had sharply reduced their purchases of Russian energy, he said. He described the loss of that market as one of the costs Moscow faced for pursuing the war. Russia was now selling its energy elsewhere at a steep discount, Sikorski said. Poland did not want to become dependent on supplies from a country that invaded its neighbours, he added. Sikorski said the G20 discussions had addressed freedom of navigation, energy and food security. Despite differences among the countries represented, he argued that dialogue needed to continue."There are countries here represented that don't necessarily see eye to eye, but we need to keep the conversation going."He also called for a Black Sea ceasefire to help food exports reach countries such as Egypt. Asked about progress, he referred to Turkish and Indian initiatives and urged quick action to meet the needs of people in the Global South. The Strait of Hormuz lies between Iran and Oman and connects the Persian Gulf with the Gulf of Oman and the Arabian Sea. In 2024, oil flows through it averaged about 20 million barrels a day. About one-fifth of global LNG trade also passed through Hormuz in 2024, chiefly from Qatar. India was among the leading Asian destinations for both crude oil and LNG shipped through the strait, according to the agency.

ph.title: Leo XIV has become the first pope in history to vote in a US general election
ph.description: VATICAN CITY (AP) — Pope Leo XIV has become the first pontiff to vote in a U.S. general election, casting a mail-in ballot in a contest that will decide America's political future as the Trump era slowly comes to an end. The Vatican confirmed Friday that the Chicago-born pontiff had submitted a mail-in ballot in the city ahead of the Nov. 3 midterm elections, citing his long-standing belief in civic participation. Leo, formerly Robert Prevost, "has exercised his right to vote as a United States citizen" as he has done "whenever he was eligible to do so," the Holy See press office said. The statement said he had also voted while living in Peru, where he lived as a missionary priest and bishop for over 20 years. "The Holy Father expresses his belief in the right and the duty of citizens to participate in democratic processes," it added. Leo holds U.S. and Peruvian citizenship, and is also the head of state of a foreign country, the Holy See. The city-state is an absolute monarchy with no political elections. U.S. federal law allows citizens living abroad, even those working for foreign governments, to vote via absentee ballot. Americans working for foreign governments aren't automatically at risk of forfeiting their U.S. citizenship, though the U.S. State Department says on its website that it may "actively review" the citizenship status of Americans who "serve as a foreign head of state, foreign head of government, or foreign minister." This election, Illinois voters are deciding whether to elect Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker to his third term, and they're also filling an open U.S. Senate seat after longtime Catholic Democrat Dick Durbin's retirement. There are no statewide issues on the Illinois ballot. President Donald Trump is not on the ballot, but he has campaigned hard to try to preserve Republican control of the U.S. House and Senate for the final two years of his second term. The pope, registered at a New Lenox, Illinois, address, requested a mail-in ballot on Oct. 3, said Kim Fladhammer, chief of staff to the Will County clerk, on Friday. The Chicago Sun-Times first reported the request. The request was made just 10 days before Leo underwent surgery to remove a cancerous tumor from his right lung. Leo has been slowly resuming his activities at the Vatican after being released from the hospital Oct. 17. It is unclear how Leo returned the ballot. The pope's older brother, John Prevost, was in Rome this week accompanying parishioners from St. Jude's, an Augustinian-run parish in New Lenox, Illinois. The elder Prevost attends Mass there, and Leo gave a talk at the parish in 2024 while still a cardinal. Prevost's past votes have gone Democratic and Republican Since 2000, Robert Prevost has voted in five primary elections, requesting Democratic ballots twice and Republican ballots three times, according to records held by the Illinois State Board of Elections. The records do not show which candidates he supported. Illinois voters must declare a party preference to receive a primary ballot. No such declaration is required in general elections. While registered in heavily Democratic Cook County, Prevost requested Democratic primary ballots in 2008 and 2010. After moving to the more conservative suburban Will County, he requested Republican primary ballots in 2012, 2014 and 2016. The records also show that he submitted ballots in every general election since 2000 except those in 2020 and 2022. Clashes with Trump Since becoming pope, Leo has drawn criticism from Trump for repeatedly condemning the U.S.-Israeli war in Iran and calling for dignified treatment of immigrants, following the Trump administration's crackdown and mass deportation program. Earlier this year, Trump called Leo "weak" and captive to the "radical left," kicking off a remarkable back-and-forth public argument that dominated Leo's April trip to Africa. Responding to Trump, Leo told reporters en route to Algeria: "I'm not afraid of the Trump administration or of speaking out loudly about the message of the Gospel, which is what the church works for." The public dispute has subsided in recent months. "We try to let things pass if there are misunderstandings," the Vatican foreign minister, Archbishop Richard Paul Gallagher, told reporters this week. "With anybody, we would be looking to approach it and say, 'OK, there may be a misunderstanding, let's move on and try to rebuild trust and confidence.'" Leo and Trump have not spoken by phone since the pope's May 2025 election. Last week, however, Leo spoke with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy about the humanitarian crisis in the Ukrainian city of Oleshky. Asked why Trump and Leo haven't spoken, Gallagher said the Holy See has found a capable conduit in the U.S. ambassador to the Holy See, Brian Burch, and hadn't needed to elevate any issue higher. A pope who follows US politics closely Leo has made clear on several occasions that he follows local and national U.S. politics closely and is not afraid to intervene. Recently, Leo reiterated official church teaching declaring the death penalty "inadmissible." He made the pronouncement in a social media post on the World Day Against the Death Penalty, which came as the U.S. announced plans to livestream an execution by firing squad. The plans were later scrapped. In 2025, Leo intervened in a debate over abortion, after Chicago Cardinal Blase Cupich announced plans to give a lifetime achievement award to Sen. Durbin. The plans drew objection from some conservative U.S. bishops given the powerful Democratic senator's support for abortion rights. Leo called for respect for both sides, but he also pointed out the contradiction between people who call themselves "pro-life" but also support the death penalty. Also in 2025, Leo said he was "very disappointed" that his home state of Illinois approved a law allowing medically assisted dying, which is condemned by the Catholic Church. The U.S. Conference of Catholic Bishops, in a note commenting on the confirmation of Leo's midterm vote, urged Catholics to put "our faith before our politics" and uphold human dignity and the common good. "As Catholics and Americans, we are blessed to be able to participate in our nation's political and public life," said the conference's director of public affairs, Chieko Noguchi. "In voting, our Holy Father sets the example that encourages each citizen to exercise their civic responsibility."

ae.title: Cake Digital Bank Wins Gold at Qorus-Infosys Finacle Banking Innovation Awards 2026
ae.description: ROME, Oct. 31, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Cake Digital Bank, a digital-only bank from Vietnam, has won Gold at the Qorus-Infosys Finacle Banking Innovation Awards 2026 for its initiative, "Reinventing Financial Experiences Through an AI-First Banking Model." Cake was the only financial institution from Vietnam recognized at this year's awards. The winners were celebrated in Rome, Italy, during Infosys Finacle Conclave 2026. The 13th edition of the awards attracted 538 submissions from 206 financial institutions across 68 countries, with 37 institutions recognized across ten award categories. The selection process combined voting by industry peers with evaluation by an expert jury of 81 senior banking executives. The award-winning institutions included leading international banking names such as Santander, Commonwealth Bank, DBS, Maybank, and CaixaBank, reflecting the global scope and competitive landscape of the awards. John Berry, Chairman of Qorus, observed that the banking industry is entering a new era in which AI is becoming integral to innovation, transforming initiatives and expanding the possibilities of financial services. Building an AI-First Banking Model from the Ground Up As artificial intelligence becomes increasingly central to banking innovation, financial institutions face a growing challenge: translating technological capabilities into better customer experiences, greater operational efficiency, and sustainable business performance. Cake's AI-first approach reflects this industry shift while taking a different starting point. Rather than integrating AI into established banking processes, Cake was built as a digital-only bank from the outset, embedding AI, data, and automation into its technology architecture, operating model, and customer journeys. This greenfield foundation has enabled Cake to develop an integrated AI-first banking model, where technology supports how the bank makes decisions, manages operations, and delivers financial services at scale. Supported by its independently developed core banking and card management systems, Cake applies AI across the banking value chain, from customer onboarding, credit assessment, and fraud prevention to risk management, customer service, and personalized financial recommendations. Beyond operational efficiency, Cake has also invested in localized AI capabilities designed specifically for Vietnamese users, enabling more accessible, responsive, and personalized financial experiences. Scaling Growth with Efficiency and Sustainable Business Performance Nearly six years since its launch, Cake has grown to serve more than 8 million customers, demonstrating the scalability of its branchless digital banking model. Cake achieved positive EBITDA in Q3 2024, just 3.5 years after launch, marking a significant milestone in demonstrating the viability of its digital-only banking model. The bank subsequently recorded 173% year-on-year revenue growth in 2025, followed by a further 121% growth in 2026, reflecting sustained business momentum as it continues to scale. Meanwhile, average revenue per user (ARPU) increased from USD 12 in 2024 to USD 44 in 2026, highlighting Cake's ability to generate greater value from its growing customer base. Beyond customer acquisition, Cake's growth strategy increasingly focuses on deepening customer relationships and expanding the range of financial needs served through its platform and partner ecosystems. This approach reflects the bank's evolution toward a mature digital banking model, where scale is complemented by stronger customer engagement, operational efficiency, and long-term business sustainability. Nguyen Huu Quang, CEO of Cake Digital Bank, said: "Winning Gold at the Qorus-Infosys Finacle Banking Innovation Awards is a meaningful international recognition of Cake's AI-first banking model. From the beginning, our ambition has been to build a digital bank that combines technological innovation with sustainable business performance, while making financial services simpler, more accessible, and more relevant to customers. This recognition reinforces our commitment to delivering world-class banking experiences for Vietnamese users and continuing to advance our AI-first capabilities." The Gold Award marks another milestone in Cake's development as a next-generation AI-first digital bank. It also demonstrates how a banking model developed and scaled in an emerging market can deliver meaningful customer and business outcomes, contributing practical perspectives to the global conversation on the future of digital banking. In September 2026, Cake was also named "Vietnam's Best Digital Bank" by Euromoney under its Group Level Banking Awards, further recognizing the bank's progress in strategy, technology, and business performance. About the Qorus-Infosys Finacle Banking Innovation Awards The Qorus-Infosys Finacle Banking Innovation Awards are jointly organized by Qorus, a global association for retail financial institutions, and Infosys Finacle, a digital banking solutions provider. Now in their 13th edition, the awards recognize innovative initiatives and banking models that deliver meaningful impact across the global financial services industry.

cm.title: Education : l’UNESCO dote le Cameroun pour mieux piloter les apprentissages
cm.description: © DR Le vendredi 30 octobre 2026, l’UNESCO a remis 25 ordinateurs portables et des équipements techniques à l’Équipe opérationnelle permanente et à l’Unité pilote des acquis scolaires. Objectif : renforcer le suivi, l’évaluation et la qualité de l’éducation au Cameroun. L’UNESCO renforce les capacités de pilotage et d’évaluation des apprentissages au Cameroun. Le vendredi 30 octobre 2026, l’organisation a officiellement remis des équipements informatiques à l’Équipe opérationnelle permanente (EOP) et à l’Unité pilote des acquis scolaires (UPAS). La dotation comprend 25 ordinateurs portables, des équipements d’impression et de projection, des logiciels spécialisés et des outils de travail collaboratif. La remise s’inscrit dans le cadre du Programme d’Appui à la Professionnalisation du Métier de l’Enseignant au Cameroun (PAPMEC). La cérémonie, marquée par la signature d’un accord de transfert de propriété avec le Ministère de l’Éducation de Base (MINEDUB), constitue une nouvelle avancée dans le renforcement des capacités nationales de coordination, de suivi et d’évaluation du système éducatif. Grâce à cette dotation, les équipes disposent désormais de moyens techniques supplémentaires pour améliorer le pilotage des activités du programme, faciliter le traitement et l’analyse des données sur les acquis scolaires et éclairer les décisions en faveur de la qualité des apprentissages. Réaffirmant l’engagement de l’UNESCO à accompagner les efforts nationaux, le Directeur et Représentant a.i. du Bureau régional de l’UNESCO pour l’Afrique centrale a souligné : « Pour l’UNESCO, cette démarche s’inscrit pleinement dans notre mandat de coopération avec les États membres, de renforcement des capacités nationales et de promotion d’une éducation inclusive et de qualité. » Financé par le Partenariat mondial pour l’éducation (GPE) et mis en œuvre conjointement par l’UNESCO et l’UNICEF, le PAPMEC accompagne les efforts du Gouvernement camerounais en faveur de la professionnalisation du métier d’enseignant et de l’amélioration de la qualité de l’éducation. Cet article Education : l’UNESCO dote le Cameroun pour mieux piloter les apprentissages est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com.
